title: MZ Changing how the ScreenZoom plugin scales the tileset

posts.author: tankhedgehog
posts.body:
I've been banging my head against a wall for a while now, trying to get 16 x 16 tiles wotrking and I'm almost there. I've got the various pixel perfect plugins (TDDP_PixelPerfect and OpenTypePixelFont) going and that's all working. To counter the wide view, I'm using the ScreenZoom plugin (that comes with RPG Maker MZ) to zoom in an even 2x (to avoid wierd sprite stretching) and the actors all look great, the menu looks great, but for some reason, the zoom absolutely butchers the map. Here's what I'm talking about.
Spoiler:
Tileset blurring
On the left is what it looks like when zoomed in with the plugin, on the right is how that same tree looks when not zoomed in (scaled up 2x in gimp after taking the screenshot).
I haven't seen anyone else complaining about this, so I can only assume it's because I'm using Visustella's Tiled plugin so I can do all my maps in Tiled. Or atleast, that's the only thing I can think of. Does anyone have any ideas for how I can fix this? My first thought was changing how the ScreenZoom plugin scales things (hence the title), but if anyone has any other ideas I'm all ears.
